clinical.citation: A functional role for Septin-2 in the maintenance of the axon initial segment and in human cognitive development (PMID: 41408595)

variants.description: Specific variant notations not given in the abstract. Mutations reported in five unrelated individuals and one mother-daughter duo, predicted to preclude Septin-2 homodimerization (dominant negative).
phenotypes: cognitive impairment (in the majority of individuals)
impaired higher cognitive function / neurodevelopmental phenotype

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Predicted dominant-negative effect blocking septin octamer assembly by preventing Septin-2 homodimerization. Mutant constructs in neurons caused loss of AIS Ankyrin G, aberrant MAP2 in the distal axon, axonal shortening and hypoexcitability, and the Ankyrin G interaction was largely ablated. The variant type is inferred from the dominant-negative and homodimerization mechanism, not stated in the abstract.

model_organism.citation: Hypoxia exposure impairs male fertility via inhibiting Septin2-mediated spermatogonial proliferation (PMID: 40487848)
phenotypes: Sept2 knockdown in normoxic mice phenocopied hypoxia-induced spermatogenesis defects
G1-S phase arrest in spermatogonial cells upon Sept2 depletion
Reduced AKT phosphorylation via PP2A/B56γ stabilization
Hypoxia downregulated Sept2 in spermatogonia and impaired fertility, sperm quality, and testicular histology
model_organism.sample_size: n = 3-5 mice per intervention group; hypoxic mouse model n = 5

model_organism.citation: SEPTIN7 Deficiency Disrupts Endothelial Integrity and Causes Myxomatous Valve Disease in Juvenile Mice (PMID: 42657464)
phenotypes: Endocardial lineage-specific Septin2 conditional knockout mice developed normally without detectable abnormalities
No detectable cardiac or valve abnormalities in Septin2 mutants (in contrast to Septin7 mutants, which had juvenile lethality and myxomatous valve disease)

model_organism.citation: Toriyama et al. 2017 - Folate-dependent methylation of septins governs ciliogenesis during neural tube closure (PMID: 28432198)
phenotypes: Disruption of folate-mediated methylation pathway compromised neural tube closure and ciliogenesis
Embryos with neural tube defects failed to adequately methylate septin2
Septin2 methylation affected GTP binding and septin2-6-7 complex formation

biological.citation: Toriyama et al. 2017 - Folate-dependent methylation of septins governs ciliogenesis during neural tube closure (PMID: 28432198)
biological.summary: Folate-dependent one-carbon methylation pathway regulates septin2 methylation. Embryos with neural tube defects failed to adequately methylate septin2. Methylation affects its GTP binding and formation of the septin2-6-7 complex, which is critical for ciliogenesis and neural tube closure.

biological.citation: 2019 - Septin2 mediates podosome maturation and endothelial cell invasion associated with angiogenesis (PMID: 31865373)
biological.summary: Septin2, Septin6 and Septin7 are required for maturation of endothelial podosomes into matrix-degrading organelles. Septin2 is recruited after Tks5 and F-actin and localizes around the podosome perimeter, where it forms a diffusion barrier. Its phosphoinositide-binding residues are required for podosome function and for angiogenic endothelial invasion.

biological.citation: 2024 - S-Nitrosylation of Septin2 Exacerbates Aortic Aneurysm and Dissection by Coupling the TIAM1-RAC1 Axis in Macrophages (PMID: 38357802)
biological.summary: Septin2 is S-nitrosylated at Cys111 in aortic tissue from dissection patients and in Ang II-infused Apoe-/- mice. SNO-Septin2 has reduced interaction with TIAM1, which activates RAC1 and NF-κB signaling, driving macrophage inflammation and extracellular matrix degradation. RAC1 inhibitors (R-Ketorolac, NSC23766) were protective.

biological.citation: 2023 - SEPTIN2 suppresses an IFN-γ-independent, proinflammatory macrophage activation pathway (PMID: 37978190)
biological.summary: SEPT2 was identified by high-content screening as a negative regulator of IFN-γ-independent macrophage autoactivation. ER stress induces SEPT2, which balances acetylation and ubiquitination of HSPA5 at K327, alleviating ER stress and limiting M1-like polarization and cytokine release.

biological.citation: 2023 - Lysyl hydroxylase LH1 promotes confined migration and metastasis of cancer cells by stabilizing Septin2 to enhance actin network (PMID: 36721170)
biological.summary: LH1 binds and stabilizes SEPT2 in a hydroxylase-domain-dependent manner, enhancing actin polymerization and confined migration and metastasis in HCC and PDAC. Tumors with high LH1 and SEPT2 had the poorest prognosis.

biological.citation: 2018 - Coupling function of cyclin-dependent kinase 2 and Septin2 in the promotion of hepatocellular carcinoma (PMID: 30444001)
biological.summary: CDK2 and SEPT2 show similar cell-cycle dynamics with peak protein levels in G2/M. CDK2 interacts with and stabilizes SEPT2. Their expression is correlated in HCC tissue, and high co-expression is associated with relapse, poor differentiation and microvascular invasion.
biological.sample_size: 8 paired fresh HCC tissues; 100 HCC patients

biological.citation: 2004 - Functional interdependence between septin and actin cytoskeleton (PMID: 15541171)
biological.summary: Septin2 filaments associate with actin bundles but are excluded from dynamic leading edges and ruffles. Septin2 assemblies are highly dynamic by FRAP independent of actin. RNAi and truncation experiments show Septin2 stabilizes or maintains actin stress fibres.

biological.citation: 2025 - Hypoxia exposure impairs male fertility via inhibiting Septin2-mediated spermatogonial proliferation (PMID: 40487848)
biological.summary: Hypoxia downregulates Sept2 transcription in spermatogonia by disrupting POLR2A binding to the Sept2 promoter. Sept2 loss stabilizes PP2A B56γ, causing AKT dephosphorylation and G1-S arrest. Sept2 knockdown in mice phenocopied the hypoxic spermatogenesis defects, and overexpression rescued proliferation in vitro.
biological.sample_size: 24 high-altitude residents, 6 pathological hypoxia patients, 19 controls; mouse n=3-5/group

biological.citation: 2010 - Septin2 is modified by SUMOylation and required for chromosome congression in mouse oocytes (PMID: 20372094)
biological.summary: Septin2 is SUMO-1 modified in mouse oocytes and localizes to the spindle and midbody. Inhibitor or siRNA disruption of septins causes chromosome misalignment and failure of the metaphase I/anaphase I transition via spindle checkpoint activation, but does not affect cytokinesis.

biological.citation: 2014 - FHL2-driven molecular network mediated Septin2 knockdown inducing apoptosis in mesangial cell (PMID: 25103794)
biological.summary: FHL2 is a new Septin2 interaction partner. Septin2 knockdown induces rat mesangial cell apoptosis via FHL2-mediated p-ERK1 and p-AKT signaling. FHL2 overexpression alleviates the apoptosis.
